title: TEMPLATE
medium: the starting point for a new piece: canvas lib (core, live, ink, rig, recursion) + a three-mode main
summary: Copy this folder to start a piece. An 8-bar loop that exercises the lib: a hand-lettered title writing itself on, a figure seated on a chair built from its body (contacts logged, ?qa=1 draws them), a planted-feet walk on the beat, and a vector droste into the window that loops back to the title.

gallery.alt: A plain ink line drawing on cream paper: a figure at a café table under a hanging lamp. A hand-lettered title writes itself on, the figure sits, gets up and walks away, and the view falls through the window back to the title.
